# SemanticSovereignty.com

Independent reference project on semantic sovereignty, machine-readable authority, and independent knowledge infrastructures.

## Purpose

SemanticSovereignty.com provides an independent reference on semantic sovereignty, authority structures, provenance, and machine-readable knowledge infrastructures.
